'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Uzbekistan]] suspends the use of [[Russia]]'s [[Payment card|card payment system]] [[Mir (payment system)|Mir]]. The move was supposedly warranted by the need "to carry out the necessary technical procedures" and was not related to sanctions. [https://www.euronews.com/next/2022/09/24/ukraine-crisis-mir-uzbekistan (Euronews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**The [[Iranian government]] announces that security forces have regained control of [[Oshnavieh]], a day after protestors allegedly "took control" of the city. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-63021113 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Italian general election]]
**[[Italians]] head to the polls to elect members of the [[Parliament of Italy|Parliament]]. [https://apnews.com/article/elections-voting-italy-matteo-salvini-c251832f5b73063b2e20869a21f92efe (AP)]
**[[Exit poll]]s show that the [[centre-right coalition]] led by [[Brothers of Italy]] leader [[Giorgia Meloni]] has won the election with a majority of seats in the [[Italian Parliament]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63029909 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 Cuban Family Code referendum]]
**[[Cubans]] vote on legalizing [[same-sex marriage]] and [[same-sex adoption]]. The [[government of Cuba|government]] urges people to vote in favour of legalization while the [[Catholic Church]] urges people to vote against legalization. [https://m.dw.com/en/cuba-holds-referendum-on-same-sex-marriage-adoption/a-63231499 (DW)]
*[[2022 Swiss referendums]]
**The [[Switzerland|Swiss]] go to the polls to decide four ballot questions. The voters agree to raise the retirement age for women to 65 and to increase the [[Taxation_in_Switzerland#Value_added_tax|value added tax]] rates from 7.7% to 8.1%. However, voters rejected the proposal to exempt domestic bonds from taxation and to ban [[intensive animal farming]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-09-25/swiss-back-plan-to-work-longer-raise-vat-to-pay-for-pensions (Bloomberg)] [https://www.swissinfo.ch/fre/votations-f%C3%A9d%C3%A9rales-du-25-septembre-2022/47819160 (Swissinfo)]
